newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish C/A H1 gap at $2.659 bln - Finance Ministry. [CORRECTED 13:28 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Polish C/A H1 gap at $2.659 bln - Finance Ministry. [CORRECTED 13:28 GMT]

text.p: Poland's current account gap in the first-half of this year widened to $2.659 billion from May's year-to-date $2.41 billion and from a $312-million gap a year ago, preliminary finance ministry data showed. (Corrects that the c/a gap in the first-half was larger than both the May year-to-date figure and the year ago figure.)

Our preliminary estimates show that after the first six months of the year the current account gap was $2.659 billion. Final data may show the deficit at between $2.6-2.7 billion which is roughly 3.5-3.6 percent of gross domestic product," Finance Minister Marek Belka told a news conference.
